purpose: Raw YouTube search results and decisions of the frozen PR #31 upload search for the VGT-7 held-out list. The results come from the Aside test browser (signed-in profile, one point in time); this log is the record.
method: Per song, Q1 then Q2 opened as https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=<query> in one Aside tab; after DOMContentLoaded and 2.5 s, every videoRenderer in window.ytInitialData in document order (shelves included); the first 15 kept with rank = position. title = title runs, channel = ownerText runs, lengthText = lengthText.simpleText ('' when absent). 'extra' (channel id, owner badge styles, first description snippet) is recorded for the record only and is not used by any rule; videoRenderers = how many the page had.
rules: src/eval/heldout-uploads.ts (checkResult, chooseUpload); decisions below are recomputed by scripts/heldout-songs.mjs list and must match.
notes: Before the logged run, rank 1 (Robert Palmer, Addicted To Love) was searched before: once with both queries to check the result format, and once more with Q1 only to inspect the channel fields. Those results are not in the log; rank 1 was searched again in the logged run.

At 16:39 the batch for ranks 67-76 could not connect to Aside (Could not connect to Aside at http://127.0.0.1:21420) and returned no results; Aside answered again seconds later and the same batch was run from rank 67. No result of that failed attempt exists.

Observed: auto-generated 'Provided to YouTube' uploads of artists with an official artist channel appear under the artist's channel name (for example 'Robert Palmer', same channel id as the music video), not '<artist> - Topic'. The frozen rule requires the ' - Topic' suffix and is applied as written.

Amendment amended-v1 (2026-11-13): Under topic-only-v1 only 25 of 136 searched songs qualified: artists with an official artist channel publish their auto-generated 'Provided to YouTube' tracks under the artist channel name, not '<artist> - Topic', so the rule kept mostly artists without such a channel. Decided by the Paseo parent after an Astra advisor round, before any capture; re-judged from this same log, no new searches. All other conditions, query limits, ordering, tie-break and the stop at 25 are unchanged. Each entry keeps 'decision' (topic-only-v1) and gains 'decisionAmended'; entries past the amended stop (rank 32) are 'not needed: beyond the amended stop'.

amendment.topicOnlyChannelRule: the channel name ends with ' - Topic', and its artist part, normalized, contains or is contained in the normalized Billboard artist (normalized Topic artist part nonempty)
amendment.amendedChannelRule: A result satisfies the channel condition if either: (1) its channel name ends with the exact suffix ' - Topic', and the channel name with that suffix removed and the Billboard artist, both normalized by the existing normalization, are nonempty and either contains the other; or (2) its channel name does not end with that suffix, its recorded extra.snippet starts exactly and case-sensitively with 'Provided to YouTube by', its recorded extra.ownerBadges contains BADGE_STYLE_TYPE_VERIFIED_ARTIST, and its full channel name and the Billboard artist, normalized as above, are nonempty and either contains the other. Missing snippet or badge data fails branch (2).
amendment.reason: Under topic-only-v1 only 25 of 136 searched songs qualified: artists with an official artist channel publish their auto-generated 'Provided to YouTube' tracks under the artist channel name, not '<artist> - Topic', so the rule kept mostly artists without such a channel. Decided by the Paseo parent after an Astra advisor round, before any capture; re-judged from this same log, no new searches. All other conditions, query limits, ordering, tie-break and the stop at 25 are unchanged.
